semantics: Preparation delays while HAVG(ZPREP)-HPREP>0 and DELAY_PREP<MAXPREPDELAY; delayed marker DVS=-0.3.
DELAY_SOW inherits DELAY_PREP at each preparation update.
Sowing delays while soil temperature is below TEMPSOW or HAVG(ZSOW)-HSOW>0 and DELAY_SOW<MAXSOWDELAY; delayed marker DVS=-0.2.
Germination mode 1 uses TSUMEMEOPT with clipped thermal increment between TBASEM and TEFFMX.
Germination mode 2 modifies the effective emergence requirement by dry/optimal/wet pressure-head branches using SWAP-derived BGERM/CGERM.
Before emergence DVS=-0.1*max(1-TSUMGERM/TSUMEMEOPT,0); at completion DVS=0.

h_average.semantics: Thickness-weighted mean of pF=log10(max(1,-h)) from surface to monitoring depth, transformed back as -10**pF; z=0 uses top node.

forcing: average pressure head at preparation/sowing/germination depths

remaining: Compose rotation season start, pre-emergence owner reset and crop-owner initialization atomically.
Persist/restart pre-emergence owner across delays and fallow.
Qualify crop emergence boundary replay/rejection and soil-state preservation.
